material.acceptance_criteria: Hover on a builtin such as effect returns its parameter names taken from the engine's own builtin documentation rather than a fixed string, and completion items carry that signature as detail.
material.description: rust/crates/mod-lsp/src/main.rs hover returns the fixed text 'engine builtin from the osdt-data schema' for any builtin name, and completion emits bare names with kind 3 and no detail. The engine's starlark builtins (rust/crates/data/src/builtins.rs, GlobalsBuilder) already carry each builtin's parameters. CI (ci.yml mod-lsp job) checks only that the label grid appears in completion and never sends a hover request.
material.resolution: .star completion detail and hover signatures now come from the engine's own GlobalsBuilder documentation via builtins::signatures(), not a hand list. CI hover step over stdio checks effect's five parameters and prints lsp hover ok name=effect params=5.
material.subject: .star hover is a fixed sentence and completion carries no engine signature or documentation
material.witness: ci-status run 38907664432 job 116995241263; builtins.rs:27 signatures(), mod-lsp main.rs:110,127
material.witness_plan: The mod-lsp CI job sends a hover request at a builtin position and a completion request with resolve, then asserts that two named parameters of effect appear in the hover text and the detail field.

note: .star completion detail and hover signatures now come from the engine's own GlobalsBuilder documentation via builtins::signatures(), not a hand list. CI hover step over stdio checks effect's five parameters and prints lsp hover ok name=effect params=5.
